//: Emits dist/durable-object/* with the Workers runtime types. Separate from tsconfig.build.json because @cloudflare/workers-types redefines globals that conflict with @types/node on the core import path (e.g. TextDecoder); skipLibCheck (from the base) covers the cross-.d.ts conflicts, and the DO subtree only reaches core/ledger + core/errors, neither of which uses a conflicting global. Types never change the emitted JS, so the core files this also re-emits are byte-identical to the main build's.
